skill.name: template-skill
skill.description: A minimal starter template for creating an AI skill with frontmatter and an instruction section.
skill.summary: Start a new Claude, Codex, or Claude Code skill from a simple scaffold.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. Manual review found no prompt injection attempt, executable behavior, network use, filesystem access, or secret-handling intent.

content.user_title: Create a Basic AI Skill Template
content.value_statement: New skill authors need a simple starting point. This template provides minimal frontmatter and a placeholder instruction section for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Provides a minimal SKILL.md file structure.
Includes frontmatter with a skill name and description field.
Marks where authors should add instructions.
Works as a starter scaffold for supported AI tools.
Contains no scripts, dependencies, or executable code.
limitations: It does not provide a finished task workflow.
It requires authors to replace the placeholder description.
It does not include examples, tests, or automation.
It does not validate the quality of added instructions.

use_cases.title: Draft a New Skill
use_cases.description: Use the scaffold to create the first version of a simple AI skill.

use_cases.title: Teach Skill Structure
use_cases.description: Show new contributors the minimum files and fields a skill needs.

use_cases.title: Standardize Starter Files
use_cases.description: Use the same basic layout before adding project-specific instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this template to draft a new skill for [task]. Add a clear name, description, and short instruction section.

prompt_templates.title: Improve the Placeholder
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace the placeholder text with instructions for [workflow]. Keep each instruction specific, safe, and easy to test.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Marketplace Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this template into a marketplace-ready skill for [audience]. Include capabilities, limits, examples, and safe usage guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Added Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the completed skill for unclear scope, unsafe instructions, prompt injection risks, and missing user guidance.

output_examples.input: Create a starter skill for writing concise release notes.
output_examples.output: A skill outline with a release notes description, focused instructions, and clear guidance for concise summaries.

output_examples.input: Prepare this scaffold for a documentation review workflow.
output_examples.output: A customized skill concept that reviews documentation for clarity, missing steps, and inconsistent terminology.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder before publishing the skill.
Keep instructions narrow, testable, and linked to a clear user task.
Review added text for prompt injection or requests for secret data.
anti_patterns: Publishing the template without task-specific instructions.
Adding broad instructions that override user or system safety rules.
Mixing unrelated workflows into one starter skill.

faq.question: Is this a complete skill?
faq.answer: No. It is a starter template that needs task-specific instructions before use.

faq.question: Does it run code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill contains only a small Markdown file with placeholder text.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I change first?
faq.answer: Start with the description and replace the placeholder instruction section with your real workflow.

faq.question: Can I publish it as is?
faq.answer: It is not useful as published content until the placeholders are replaced.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: No. Authors should add safe boundaries and review any new instructions before release.
